summary: Small sealed bush car park off the freeway, no homes nearby, level.
reasons: Sealed surface on a mapped road

drivers.seclusion: Enclosed by bush on all sides; no buildings listed or visible. A works yard sits about 40 m north-west, behind trees.
drivers.access_and_room: Asphalt road about 3 m away runs into the car park. Sealed area roughly 15 by 20 m, room for a van. No gate seen.
drivers.traffic: Little through traffic on a dead-end spur; freeway noise likely.
drivers.convention: Mapped car park with painted bays; no vehicles seen in either image.

flags: Slope steep off the pad: ground drops sharply to the east
Private service road and no-access track mapped nearby
sun_shade: Heavy tree cover on the north and east sides; shaded in the morning, more open to the west and south.
cannot_judge: Whether the car park is locked at night

best_section.where: Small sealed car park at the ring, reached by the asphalt road from the south-east
